blocks.text: Asia’s expanding health and wellness sector took center stage at Vitafoods Asia 2026, which gathered more than 16,000 visitors from around 80 countries and some 800 exhibitors at the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center in Bangkok. The three-day international event connected businesses across the health and nutrition value chain, including ingredient suppliers, manufacturers, technology providers, finished-product companies, researchers, and global brands. The gathering also provided entrepreneurs, startups, and micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs) with opportunities to discover emerging trends, build international partnerships, and explore the growing nutraceutical, functional food, pharmaceutical, cosmetics, and wellness markets.
